long_biography.plain_text:
Christian Engel was born in Weiden and studied business administration in Mannheim before joining the family enterprise. His father, Paul Engel, had acquired the company's corrugated-machinery business and offered him a route into it. Engel began with Asian regional sales, a period he later described as a demanding education in customers and markets.

At BHS he and Lars Engel moved the company beyond traditional equipment manufacture. Their strategy combined complete corrugators with digital printing, data-led maintenance and intralogistics, aiming to support a plant through its operating life. Engel is a board member of both the LUCE and Angels for Children foundations. LUCE funds education and research in the Upper Palatinate; Angels for Children supports schools and vocational training in Laos.
